{{Quote|You have killed my son! You monster!|Lonai's father|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Lonai's father''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kumumgah/Legends|Kumumgah]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with [[Lonai|his son]] during the [[Pre-Republic era]]. He and his [[Parent/Legends|son]] was among the survivors that were brought before [[Predor]] [[Tul'kar]] and [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] during the culling of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. When Xesh sensed the [[Force power/Legends|Force]] within his son Lonai and caused his death, Lonai's father was devastated because of the scene and angrily declared to Predor Tul'kar that the Kumumgah would someday drive the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] away from Tatooine by fighting back. Amused, Predor Tul'kar stated that it was unlikely to occur before shocking Lonai's father to [[Death/Legends|death]].
